blocking_finding.impact: A normal direct Rotten link containing a smoke route but lacking the explicit automation opt-in silently controls combat and may mutate market/reacquisition state, so manual-play and smoke-evidence boundaries are not trustworthy.

positive: Seed/plan/routing/build/market rules are pure typed modules.
Market transition is a single immutable reducer and exact carry is derived from one pure state.
Combat controller owns enemies, projectiles, bombs and collider cleanup; observed reward/retry/Stage-2 states had zero combat objects.
Existing campaign combat scenes are unchanged; only title/preload/config integration seams changed.
residuals: RottenRunScene is 1057 lines and mirrors phase/loadout/route/trace fields beside RottenPureRunState; LEAF-004 reuse should extract stage orchestration instead of cloning Stage 1.
The scene installs persistent keyboard.on handlers on create; no duplicate listener or canvas was observed, but explicit scene-shutdown ownership is not documented.
A hidden 280 ms market-entry input lock can swallow an extremely fast first choice without feedback.

accessibility.focus_semantics: Keyboard controls worked with BODY active.
accessibility.residual: Canvas-only UI exposes zero focusable elements, zero ARIA/role nodes, empty DOM text, and canvas tabIndex -1; Tab leaves focus on BODY.

ranked_repair: Gate every Rotten compatibility/encounter/heal/poor/reacquisition automation fixture with smokeAutoEnabled(), while preserving normal mode/seed route loading; add one regression proving a smoke route without smokeAuto=1 stays manual and the same route with smokeAuto=1 still automates.
